answer: Each identity is welded to one $45 TPM chip that signs a fresh pulse every epoch, a beat no clone can fake. Enrollment adds a bond that rides a rising tide, $10 times the square of the identities you already hold, so the first costs $10 and the hundredth $100,000. A comet pass sweeps a random 5% of quotes each epoch and auditors recheck them against the maker's chain within 48 hours. One forged quote burns every bond in that batch. Running 100 clones costs $3,383,500 in bonds plus $4,500 in chips, against $55 for one honest agent. A fake fleet is a house on a fault line mid-quake.
